exposure: Bubble Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) for respiratory distress
cohort: 100 neonates admitted to the NICU with respiratory distress and Downes scores between 3 and 6.
finding: Bubble CPAP is an effective and safe initial modality for managing respiratory distress in neonates, with favorable outcomes significantly associated with higher gestational age, complete antenatal steroid administration, and lower Downes scores.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly associated with better outcomes.
gest_age: Measured, but no specific inclusion range mentioned (higher gestational age associated with better outcomes).
